title: 第13章 我囤囤囤
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

七七八八的调料买下来，又花了十一万。

紧接着，谭筝买了一些腌制品，如酸菜、腊肉、火腿、泡椒……在烹饪的时候增添食物风味，还有炖汤时需要的红枣、桂圆、枸杞之类的干货。

这部分支出不多，小两万。

以上这些采购完，就来到了谭筝最期待的环节了，买各种好吃的。

速食必不可少，不但省燃料，还省时间。

“各个口味的方便面，螺蛳粉、酸辣粉、自热米饭，还有速冻水饺、速冻包子、鸡排、鸡块这类的半成品……对了，八宝粥、花生牛奶这类开盖即食的，也要。”

“曹老板，你这有没有预制菜啊？就是热一下就直接能吃的那种，比速食稍微丰富一点。”

曹顺停下登记的动作，思索了一会，说：“有的有的，市面上常见的菜色都有，价格也很实惠。”

“那这个预制菜也来一点吧，凑个十万。”

若是实力允许，就不必费尽心思挑挑拣拣，直接全买了就是，谭筝看着还没逛完的区域，有些心累。

“哇塞，曹老板，你这连蛋糕都有啊。”

冰柜里灯光明亮，各式蛋糕摆放得满满当当。

表层铺满新鲜草莓、芒果的水果蛋糕色彩鲜亮，奶油绵密蓬松；绵软的戚风蛋糕色泽金黄，气孔细腻丝滑；巧克力慕斯醇厚浓郁，表层淋着亮泽的可可酱。

还有卷着奶油与果肉的瑞士卷、点缀着坚果碎的芝士蛋糕……

“是啊，这些都是供应大商超的，工厂那边每天现做现发，品质和味道都不用担心。”

曹顺见谭筝感兴趣，立刻拉开冰柜，拿起了一个榴莲千层，拆开来让她品尝。

“来，你试试。”

谭筝也不客气，拿起勺子挖了一大口。

绵密的奶油混着醇厚的榴莲果肉在口中化开，果肉香甜软糯，带着浓郁地道的果香，薄软的饼皮层层相叠，口感轻盈不腻。

“好吃的！这冰柜里的蛋糕，每种都给我来上五十个。”

“不，每种八十个！”

“这里面有三十种口味，那一共就是两千四百个？谭老板，你确定吗？这个蛋糕得下单现做，一旦生产出来，可就不能退单了。”

“我确定，你放心下单吧。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

I bought seventy-seven or eighty-eight of the seasonings and spent another 110,000.

Immediately afterwards, Tan Zheng bought some pickled products, such as sauerkraut, bacon, ham, pickled peppers... to add flavor to the food when cooking, as well as dry goods such as red dates, longan, and wolfberry for stewing soup.

This part of the expenditure is not much, less than 20,000.

After completing the above purchases, it was time for Tan Zheng to look forward to the most exciting part, buying all kinds of delicious food.

Fast food is essential, it not only saves fuel, but also saves time.

"Instant noodles of various flavors, snail noodles, hot and sour noodles, self-heating rice, as well as semi-finished products such as quick-frozen dumplings, quick-frozen buns, chicken steaks, chicken nuggets... By the way, ready-to-eat rice pudding, peanut milk, etc. are also required."

"Boss Cao, do you have any pre-made dishes? They are the kind that can be eaten directly after being heated up. They are a little richer than fast food."

Cao Shun stopped registering, thought for a while, and said, "There are some. There are all the common dishes on the market, and the prices are very affordable."

"Then let's have some of this pre-made dish and make up one hundred thousand."

If the strength allows, there is no need to go through all the trouble to pick and choose, just buy them all. Tan Zheng looks a little tired when he looks at the area that he has not finished shopping.

"Wow, Boss Cao, you even have cake."

The freezer is brightly lit and filled with all kinds of cakes.

The fruit cake covered with fresh strawberries and mangoes is bright in color and the cream is dense and fluffy; the soft chiffon cake is golden in color with fine and silky pores; the chocolate mousse is mellow and rich, and the surface is drizzled with glossy cocoa sauce.

There are also Swiss rolls rolled with cream and fruit pulp, cheesecake dotted with chopped nuts...

"Yes, these are supplied to large supermarkets. The factory makes them fresh every day, so you don't have to worry about the quality or taste."

Seeing Tan Zheng's interest, Cao Shun immediately opened the freezer, picked up a durian millet, and opened it for her to taste.

"Come on, try it."

Tan Zheng was not polite, picked up the spoon and took a big mouthful.

The dense cream mixed with the mellow durian pulp melts in the mouth. The pulp is sweet and soft, with a rich and authentic fruity aroma. The thin and soft cake layers are stacked on top of each other, and the taste is light and not greasy.

"It's delicious! Give me fifty of each type of cake in the freezer."

"No, eighty of each kind!"

"There are thirty flavors here, so the total is 2,400? Boss Tan, are you sure? This cake must be ordered and made fresh. Once produced, the order cannot be returned."

"I'm sure, feel free to place your order."
